title: Among the players born before the year 1986, how many of them would remain
question:
Among the players born before the year 1986, how many of them would remain in his position and defense while the team attacked?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: players born before the year 1986 refers to strftime('%Y', birthday)<'1986'; players who would remain in his position and defense while the team attacked refers to defensive_work_rate = 'high'; Should consider DISTINCT in the final result;

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Player_Attributes 
WHERE XCL_131 = 'defender' 
  AND XCL_134 = 'defence' 
  AND XCL_130 IN (
    SELECT XCL_122 
    FROM Player 
    WHERE XCL_126 < 1986
  )

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.XCL_122)
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.XCL_125) < '1986'
  AND pa.XCL_136 = 'high';
